reason: BatteryPass key for the passport identifier. Its former target eubat:batteryPassportIdentifier was deleted as a duplicate of oec:passportIdentifier (EN 18223 digitalProductPassportId, EU core-vocabulary exactMatch); the key keeps its meaning and now lands on the surviving term.
Same as productIdentifier: eubat:batteryPassportIdentifier deleted as a duplicate of oec:passportIdentifier.
eubat:lastDataUpdate deleted as a duplicate of oec:lastUpdated (EN 18223 lastUpdated, EU core-vocabulary exactMatch); same datatype, same meaning.

eubat:hasInitialInternalResistance deleted: EC guidance 3.2 data point 38 asks for a cell and a pack value, and one undifferentiated value fills neither. The key keeps its upstream SAMM IRI so incoming values are preserved losslessly, as the bridge already does for other flat longlist values.
eubat:expectedNumberOfCycles deleted as a duplicate of eubat:expectedCycleLife (EU battery-vocabulary expectedLifetimeCycles exactMatch).
eubat:numberOfFullCycles deleted as a duplicate of eubat:hasCycleCount (EU battery-vocabulary numberOfChargingCycles).

eubat:expectedLifetimeYears deleted as a duplicate of eubat:hasExpectedLifetime (2026-11). The key carries a bare year count and the surviving term a gs1:QuantitativeValue, so the key keeps the upstream SAMM IRI bpsamm-perf:expectedLifetime (exactMatch of eubat:hasExpectedLifetime) and the value stays lossless.
Same as expectedLifetime: eubat:expectedLifetimeYears deleted, the bare year count lands on the upstream SAMM IRI bpsamm-perf:expectedLifetime.
eubat:hasRemainingEnergy deleted as a duplicate of eubat:hasRemainingUsableEnergy (Annex VII Part A remaining usable energy, same gs1:QuantitativeValue shape); the key keeps its meaning.
eubat:hasSelfDischargeRate deleted as a duplicate of eubat:hasCurrentSelfDischargingRate (same data point, same gs1:QuantitativeValue shape); the key keeps its meaning.
eubat:casNumber deleted as a module copy of oec:casNumber (same name, same tier AuthorizedOnly, same string value); the key keeps its meaning.
eubat:hasDismantlingDocuments deleted as a duplicate of eubat:hasDismantlingAndRemovalInformation, whose range is now eubat:DismantlingDocument; same typed document list, container unchanged.
Same as dismantlingAndRemovalInformation: eubat:hasDismantlingDocuments deleted, the documents land on eubat:hasDismantlingAndRemovalInformation.

The battery shortcut layer no longer shadows the dpp-core alias: eubat:casNumber was deleted as a module copy of oec:casNumber (same name, same tier, same string value). Stored battery passports are migrated by scripts/migrate-assessment.ts.
Same as casNumber: eubat:ecNumber deleted as a module copy of oec:ecNumber.

eubat:hasDismantlingInstructions deleted; battery dismantling documents live on eubat:hasDismantlingAndRemovalInformation, and the bare name now resolves to the dpp-core term of the same meaning (oec:hasDismantlingInstructions). Stored battery passports are migrated by scripts/migrate-assessment.ts.
The textile shortcut layer no longer shadows the dpp-core alias: eutex:ecNumber was deleted as a module copy of oec:ecNumber (same name, same tier, same string value), as eutex:casNumber was before.

The BatteryPass hazardous-substance identifier is a CAS number. Its target eubat:substanceCasNumber was deleted as a Public copy of oec:casNumber that only existed because tiers merged by local name; oec:casNumber now inherits the tier of the node that carries it, so the same value under the same key keeps its meaning.
